clauses.clause: When this creature enters, each opponent creates a 1/1 ... Pirate creature token
clauses.evidence: [cast]: 'card's triggered ability [0] triggers', 'opp:Pirate moves new -> battlefield (by card/CREATE_TOKEN)', '+ opp:Pirate (battlefield, opp, 1/1)': one 1/1 Pirate under the OPPONENT. Same on the 'enters during the opponent's turn' stimulus. Tree is the canonical B2a-whale-opponent-pirate-tokens (EachPlayer ALL_OPPONENTS).

The probe does not print colours. Pack pursued_whale_pirate_is_red_and_must_attack PASS: your Bear with protection from red (Feat of Resistance) blocks the attacking Pirate and takes no damage (ledger empty), the Pirate dies. Control with protection from white: the Pirate's 1 damage marks the Bear, so the pack depends on the token being red. TokenSpec colors=('R',).

Pack pursued_whale_pirate_cannot_block_and_forces_attacks PASS: your 3/3 attacks, Opp Bear is told not to block, and the Pirate is never offered a block (a spare decision word, which a control shows does make an unmapped blocker block, finds no Pirate ask): opponent 20 -> 17.

clauses.clause: and "Creatures you control attack each combat if able."
clauses.evidence: Pack pursued_whale_pirate_cannot_block_and_forces_attacks PASS: on the opponent's turn Opp Bear attacks although the pack declines it, and the Pirate attacks too (you 20 - 2 - 1 = 17); the mandate is the token controller's (MANDATE_ATTACK over CONTROLLER_IS YOU in the token's own abilities), so your creatures were never forced. Pack pursued_whale_pirate_is_red_and_must_attack: the Pirate attacks with no attack answer given.

clauses.clause: Spells your opponents cast that target this creature cost {3} more to cast.
clauses.evidence: Pack pursued_whale_opponent_spell_taxed_yours_not PASS: your own Shock at your Whale costs {R}; the opponent's Shock at it is refused with only {R} ('selection:off_population'), then with {3}{R} resolves and the pool is spent (4 damage total). Tree is the canonical B4-opponent-spell-cost-mana (TARGETS_SOURCE, OPPONENT, +{3}).
